entries.opening: I'm sorry for the surprise. Here is what happened, and who will look at the charge.

steps.text: Making an API key ends the free trial right away and starts the paid plan, even with trial days left.

cite.quote: your free trial ends at that moment and your paid subscription begins. This applies even if you have days remaining in your trial.

steps.text: The free trial does not include API or MCP access.

cite.quote: The free trial does not include API or MCP access.

If you would rather not keep the plan, you can cancel in Settings > Billing > View Billing Portal.

cite.quote: Go to Settings > Billing and click "View Billing Portal" to cancel your subscription.

steps.text: I am passing your message about the charge to a person on the team, with what you told me.
Payments and refunds go through Stripe, the payment processor Blotato uses.

cite.quote: Stripe is the payment processor Blotato uses for payments and refunds.

steps.text: You can see all your invoices yourself: open Settings > Billing, select View Billing Portal, then scroll to INVOICE HISTORY.

entries.opening: Of course. Here is how, and one thing to check first.

steps.text: Go to Settings > Billing and click "View Billing Portal". You can cancel there.

cite.quote: Go to Settings > Billing and click "View Billing Portal" to cancel your subscription.

steps.text: There is no long-term commitment, so you can cancel anytime.

cite.quote: There are no long-term commitments. You can cancel anytime.

steps.text: There is no pause option, so the choice is to keep the plan or cancel it.

cite.quote: Blotato does not have a pause or freeze feature.

steps.text: Before you confirm, check the date the cancellation takes effect. That is when access ends.

cite.quote: Check the cancellation's effective date before confirming when access ends.

entries.next: Open Settings > Billing > View Billing Portal.
entries.proof: You will know it worked when the Billing Portal shows the cancellation and its end date.
